DECODE R1057.summary: A cover note, not a despatch: Van Reede warns the Prince's secretary Thomas Isaac de Larrey that the real letter is written in lemon juice on the four blank half-pages of the enclosure, to be handed to the Prince of Orange; the last 21 groups are declared nulls.
DECODE R1057.en:
Monsieur de Larrey is warned that there is lemon juice [invisible ink] on the four blank half-pages of the enclosure. He
will kindly inform His Highness the Prince of Orange and be so good as to hand him my letter, which I do not address [to
him] so as not to [?…]. The following figures are nulls.

snip.cap: Van Reede to William V, 4 February 1792: the figures with the contemporary pencil gloss — ci tro n sur le(s) … demi
